rows.definition: RequestedContextTokens preserves the caller requested native context token count in a header-derived memory projection, including unknown and refused results.
rows.distinction: This is the caller input before memory resolution; native-context-resolution derives the fitting runtime token count.

rows.definition: ResolvedContextTokens is the native context token count derived by the runtime context resolver for the activated-ring memory projection snapshot; zero with UNKNOWN means unresolved.
rows.distinction: This is the resolved model window after sizing, while RequestedContextTokens preserves the caller input even when resolution cannot run.

rows.definition: serveGGUFMemoryPlanForArm derives classed weight, scratch and context memory demands from a GGUF header for the selected native serve load arm.
rows.distinction: This function produces byte demands for a chosen arm; native-context-resolution derives a token window from sizing inputs and the activated-ring fallback may replace the resulting full-residency plan.

rows.definition: serveFullPlanFitTooBig recognizes a typed compute FitError whose verdict is FitTooBig, enabling the activated-expert fallback only after a full-residency capacity refusal.
rows.distinction: This predicate recognizes an existing typed refusal and produces no memory plan; serveGGUFMemoryPlanForArm produces the demands that a fit guard judges.
